description: Build an ROI business case from your inputs: the annual value comes from the buyer's own figures when you give them (annual_value_estimate, or current_annual_cost with expected_improvement_percent); otherwise from example assumptions and benchmarks labelled for you to replace. Includes ROI, payback and an executive summary.

annual_value_estimate.description: Optional: the buyer's own estimate of the annual value in dollars; used as the value when given

current_annual_cost.description: Optional: what the problem or the current process costs the buyer a year, in dollars (their figure)

current_process.description: How they do it today. Shown in the output; not used in the calculation

expected_improvement_percent.description: Optional: the share of that annual cost the buyer expects to save, in percent (their figure)

implementation_timeline.description: Expected implementation time. Shown in the output; not used in the calculation

industry.description: Industry for the example benchmarks: Technology, Financial_Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing or Retail (exact spelling). Any other value uses Technology

known_metrics.description: Metrics the prospect shared. Shown in the output; to turn them into the value, give current_annual_cost and expected_improvement_percent, or annual_value_estimate

name: roi_business_case_builder
title: ROI Business Case Builder
